subject: R5 privacy/consent/regulatory packet ready for manager review
body: R5 now conforms to the manager evidence-review contract: source-indexed material findings, freshness/applicability notes, explicit observed-evidence vs interpretation/recommendation separation, data-classification/minimization guidance, consent/disclosure checkpoints, unresolved applicability questions, test consequences, and a statement of what the evidence does not establish. Researcher recommendation is SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS for the architectural controls and REQUIRES_HUMAN_OR_QUALIFIED_REVIEW for definitive jurisdiction/role classification.
